Android operations officer chasing humanity.

How Data connects

  • Series: Star Trek: The Next Generation — Data is the android officer of TNG.
  • Faction: Enterprise-D crew — Data is operations officer of the Enterprise-D crew.

What is Data?

Data is the Soong-type android of the Enterprise-D, a crew member whose quest to understand emotion sits beside Picard's ethics.
